feed.title: Boeing engineers union rejects new contract, votes to strike
feed.summary: Members of Boeing Co.'s engineers union, SPEEA, have rejected a proposed contract and authorized a strike, potentially impacting the certification of crucial aircraft models like the 737 Max 10 and 77X. Boeing stated that the earliest a strike could occur is October 7, and no further talks are scheduled with the union after their "strong contract offer" was turned down. The union plans to survey its members to determine what would be acceptable for a new proposal.

feed.title: Rocket Lab Stock And 2 Aerospace Picks For Rising Defense Demand
feed.summary: This article identifies three aerospace and defense stocks—Redwire (RDW), Rocket Lab (RKLB), and Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS)—that could benefit from increasing global manufacturing and rising demand for aircraft and defense hardware. These companies offer exposure to critical space infrastructure, satellite services, and unmanned aerial systems, positioning them to capitalize on long lead time projects within the defense sector.
